names.name: Awheto and ngarehu
names.said: Caterpillar fungus for the body, burnt timber for the face

text.what: Two pigments for two jobs: *awheto*, a caterpillar fungus, for the body; *ngarehu*, burnt timber, for the darker face colour.
text.story: Soot from burnt kauri gum, mixed with fat, was used as well. The pigment was kept in carved *oko* vessels, buried between uses and handed on.
